Reached TEXT-VERIFIED, 8/8 MATCH, objisolate clean. include/VirtualDoor.h was ALREADY a correctly-inheriting real header going in (struct VirtualDoor : dActor_c, real virtual dtor, real overrides) -- unlike CameraTag, no header edit was needed. Fixes applied: (1) the legacy D0 and D1 files each independently reconstructed the same `VirtualDoor::~VirtualDoor(){}` as a real out-of-line destructor -- a standard D0/D1 collapse (redefinition error), fixed by deleting one of the two duplicate bodies and letting the compiler emit both variants from the remaining one. (2) the now-familiar forced `+2` vtable addend on the factory's own vtable store, sixth confirmed occurrence with no exception across the series. (3) replaced Behavior()'s local shadow `struct Vec3 { Fix12i x,y,z; }` with the real project `Vector3` type (including the `(Vector3*)&mPosX` reinterpret-cast of the inherited position fields, matching the pattern documented in include/dActor_c.h itself) -- verified byte-identical before and after the swap; `Vector3`'s own empty `~Vector3(){}` (the ArrowSignRight/daObjPathLift_c `_ZN7Vector3D1Ev` compiler-emitted-symbol gap) is now unlicensed in this TU's object too, third confirmed occurrence, still fitting neither the compiler_only_output nor externalized_output schema. compiler_only_output covers the D2 deadstrip; externalized_output covers the six inherited base-chain RTTI objects, independently re-confirmed via direct ELF read of this TU's own compiled object (sizes/section indices match the InvisiblePole/CameraTag precedent byte-for-byte). VirtualDoor's OWN _ZTI11VirtualDoor/_ZTS11VirtualDoor are deliberately left out of externalized_output: config/arm9/overlays/ov002/symbols.txt names the immediately-preceding RTTI pair _ZTI10daChRoom_c/_ZTS10daChRoom_c (10 chars) right before VirtualDoor_SpawnInfo/_ZTV11VirtualDoor, so the ROM's actual RTTI class name is daChRoom_c -- a different string length than the decomp's VirtualDoor (11 chars), the same coined-name byte-length mismatch found on InvisiblePole/daBar_c and CameraTag/daCamTag_c, third confirmed occurrence, deferred to Phase F/attribution work.
